name: slip-e2e
description: Network e2e: deploy slip.compact to the local ledger-9 devnet and call a circuit. Deliberately a SEPARATE workspace from ../package.json: the midnight-js v5 line resolves compact-runtime 0.19.0-rc.0, while the simulator tests pin the released 0.19.0 that our compiler names. Keeping them apart stops the rc leaking into the tested path (and into the freshness gate's pin check).
